quotes.summary_phrase: Coby White on his recovery process and film study
quotes.excerpt: I picked up some great film habits, watching film, breaking down the game
quotes.quote: It has been tough, but I kind of experienced that last year. The thing I wanted to do differently this year was being intentional while I am out with what I am doing, bettering myself, whether it is through basketball or anything else. I really picked up some great film habits, watching film, breaking down the game and how I can help the team, and in what ways I can help the team, instead of just being out and feeling sorry for yourself, trying to use it for my advantage and trying to just gain the advantage for when I do come back.
